a bounded contiguous resource-table reconstruction-composition probe in ROM order, retaining 08003fa4 as assembly: 08003ed4, 08003f04, 08003f3c, 08003f78, 0800403c, 08004080, 080040b4, and 080040d0 all remained 0-difference while this owner stayed 116/124 bytes with 56 differing halfwords
bounded_search.result: No ordinary-C canonical shape reached exactness or simultaneously recovered the reference's id, block-count, scan-map, store-map, and table register roles. The retained indexed global mark loop reproduces the reference's six-instruction store loop; coupling the selected position to the result carrier preserves 120 bytes and 56 differing halfwords while reducing wrong instructions to 54. The contiguous resource-table probe preserved every exact neighbor but did not improve this owner, so its semantic and physical family alone is not evidence for a production-composition move.

remaining: The complete algorithm and owner boundary are established, but the coherent canonical translation-unit build remains four bytes short. GCC's GCSE pass copy-propagates the scan-map assignment from the store map, removing the reference's long-lived scan-map/store-map distinction and shifting the id/block-count allocation. A bounded resource-table composition retaining 08003fa4 as assembly preserved all eight exact neighbors but left this owner at 116/124 and 56 differing halfwords, so it does not justify moving the production composition. A noncanonical -fno-gcse diagnostic restores the 124-byte extent but still leaves 40 differing halfwords and 52 wrong instructions; neither exact adoption nor a permanent compiler classification is justified.
notes: Recovered only from retained assembly, approved local GS1 ROMs, neighboring exact resource-table owners, and the approved compiler.
The contiguous resource-table run is recorded as a semantic/physical reconstruction-composition probe only; the manifest continues to assert that original translation-unit boundaries are unknown.
